name: Lord Ambrose Vane

intro.text: Ah. The walker. I wondered when I'd have the pleasure. I use the word loosely.
Forty thousand columns, all perfectly sized for a gift shop floor. Do you know what I'd give to own this?
No. Of course you don't. Very well, a little sport. I expect to lose; one always does, against the earnest.

win: Yes, yes. Do take a bow. The sea seems to be getting rather close to my marquee.
after: We'll meet at the Moot. Everyone does, in the end.
